# Making a *memorable difference* with care

#### **We’re proud to be one of the world’s leaders in vehicle glass repair, replacement and
#### recalibration (VGRRR). Our 30,000 colleagues are at the heart of our business and provide an
#### outstanding service to millions of customers around the world. Our Belron global family of
#### businesses is made up of major brands operating in 42 markets around the world. We are united
#### in our purpose – to make a memorable difference with care to our customers, our people, society
#### and our shareholders.**

## Original Equipment Manufacturer

Carlex products can be found in the world’s finest automobiles. Manufacturers choose us as a
preferred partner for industry-leading technology, uncompromising quality and the unsurpassed value
of the products we make. From the earliest design concepts through product launch and mass
production, you can count on Carlex to provide unparalleled customer service and world-class
manufacturing support. [Click here to learn why Carlex is the go-to supplier of the world’s
automotive manufacturers.][47]

## Automotive Replacement Glass

Our replacement glass is manufactured with safety in mind. Each piece meets or exceeds all Federal
safety standards for automotive glass. We have offered replacement glass for many vehicle
manufactures for more than 80 years.

[Demand the best glass for your next auto glass replacement. Demand Carlex.][48]

## Careers

Carlex fosters a culture rooted in ethics, integrity, respect, safety, quality, teamwork,
accountability, customer focus and environmental stewardship. We encourage employees to challenge
and improve our processes, and supervisors to lead according to the Servant Leadership paradigm.

Are you looking for a unique career opportunity?

[Join our team!][49]

#  Automotive Glass Distributor in Wembley

### Welcome to Capital Car glass

The majority of our products are sourced direct from European manufacturers, but we also source
products from around the world. We work closely with both the OE manufacturers and after-market
replacement factories

### Our Services

To deal directly with us and create an account, simply fill out the contact or give us a call. Our
team will be happy assist you with any inquiries or requests you may have. We pride ourselves on
providing excellent customer service and high-quality glass fitting services.

[WhatsApp Image 2022-07-11 at 4.18_edited]
[WhatsApp Image 2022-07-11 at 4.19_edited]

### Export

[WhatsApp Image 2022-07-11 at 4.18.55 PM (4).jpeg]

Our extensive range of services are not limited to the United Kingdom.
Our specialist Export division can arrange to send products directly to you anywhere around the
world.


This service includes the packing, shipping and provision of all legal documentation required by
both the UK and final destination authorities.

[WhatsApp Image 2022-01-07 at 09.46_edite]

### About Us

Capital Car Glass have been in the vehicle glass repair and replacement industry for more than 18
years and till date, our main focus has never sidetracked.

 

Over the years, we have since grown from a glass fitting shop into a stockist and supplier level
glass shop that stocks and carries more than 100 different models of Genuine glass parts to ensure
that our customers' interest and needs are taken care of.

 

With our company's vision close to heart, we continue to constantly improve and upgrade ourselves so
to achieve our vision of becoming a comprehensive car glass solution provider that sets new safety,
quality and service standards.

 

At Capital Car Glass, we strongly believe that we can become a company you can rely on for all your
vehicle glass needs.

> very well and professionally. Clean and tidy service with plenty space.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

# Asahi India Glass Ltd (AIS)

Asahi India Glass Ltd (AIS) is India’s leading integrated glass and window solutions company and a
dominant player both in the automotive and the building & construction segments. Our product
solutions spanning the entire breadth of automotive, building & construction, and consumer glass,
are designed to deliver aesthetics and functional benefits.

## [AUTOMOTIVE][43]

AIS is the preferred choice of leading transport players as well as consumers of automotive glass
products. We are specialists in creating innovative glass solutions for anything that moves on
wheels, rails, water or air. Our glass solutions in the category span the entire breadth of
passenger vehicles from mass modes of transportation (buses and trains) to ships and yachts. Our
glasses are also used in defence vehicles.

## [BUILDING AND CONSTRUCTION][44]

AIS is a transformation leader in the world of architectural glass products and services. Our
architectural portfolio includes various glass solutions for exterior and interior architecture. Be
it residential or commercial projects, our premium glass solutions can be customised to optimally
suit individual design sensibilities. From privacy to safety, from thermal comfort to acoustic
insulation, our glass solutions offer the right blend of aesthetics and functionality.

## [CONSUMER ][45]

AIS caters to the modern consumer’s needs with its varied products and services under different
Strategic Business Units (SBUs) and brands. Depending upon individual needs, our customised
offerings extend from windshield repair and replacement to premium car-care services for the
automotive segment. For the windows and doors segment in residential spaces, we offer bespoke
offerings and 360-degree glass and frame solutions, specially built for institutional businesses and
homeowners, alike.

## [INDUSTRIAL ][46]

AIS is a well-known brand in the arena of industrial glass. It offers an exclusive range of glass
solutions, specifically designed for the unique needs of industries dealing in consumer durables,
commercial refrigeration, dynamic glazing and material handling vehicles. The technical, aesthetic,
energy and safety performance of our premium glass solutions make their scope of applications
practically unlimited for the industrial segment.

## Original Equipment Manufacturer

Carlex products can be found in the world’s finest automobiles. Manufacturers choose us as a
preferred partner for industry-leading technology, uncompromising quality and the unsurpassed value
of the products we make. From the earliest design concepts through product launch and mass
production, you can count on Carlex to provide unparalleled customer service and world-class
manufacturing support. [Click here to learn why Carlex is the go-to supplier of the world’s
automotive manufacturers.][47]

## Automotive Replacement Glass

Our replacement glass is manufactured with safety in mind. Each piece meets or exceeds all Federal
safety standards for automotive glass. We have offered replacement glass for many vehicle
manufactures for more than 80 years.

[Demand the best glass for your next auto glass replacement. Demand Carlex.][48]

## Careers

Carlex fosters a culture rooted in ethics, integrity, respect, safety, quality, teamwork,
accountability, customer focus and environmental stewardship. We encourage employees to challenge
and improve our processes, and supervisors to lead according to the Servant Leadership paradigm.

Are you looking for a unique career opportunity?

[Join our team!][49]

1. What is safety glass and why is it important?[Anil Kumar][43]2026-03-07T06:13:38+00:00

#### [
#### 1. What is safety glass and why is it important?
#### ][44]

Safety glass is a type of glass made to reduce injuries if the glass breaks. Normal glass can
shatter into sharp pieces, which can be dangerous. Safety glass, however, is designed to be stronger
and to break in a safer way. Because of this, it is commonly used in vehicles, buildings, and public
transport systems.

A professional safety glass manufacturer in India produces glass that can handle pressure,
vibration, and sudden impact. This is especially important for vehicles like buses and trucks that
operate on different kinds of roads every day.

There are two main types of safety glass used in the industry.

One of them is laminated glass. This glass has a plastic layer placed between two sheets of glass.
If it cracks or breaks, the pieces usually stick to that plastic layer instead of scattering
everywhere. For this reason, a bus windshield manufacturer in India generally uses laminated glass
for vehicle windshields.

The other type is tempered glass. It becomes stronger through a special heating and cooling process.
A trusted bus glass manufacturer in India often uses tempered glass for side windows and other
vehicle glass components.

Safety glass is also important in modern construction. As an experienced architectural glass
manufacturer in India, companies like Duratuf Glass supply glass that improves safety, durability,
and building performance.

2. What is laminated glass used for?[Anil Kumar][45]2026-03-07T06:13:31+00:00

#### [
#### 2. What is laminated glass used for?
#### ][46]

Laminated glass is a type of safety glass made by joining two glass layers with a plastic layer in
the middle. This middle layer helps hold the glass together if it breaks. Because of this feature,
laminated glass is widely used in both vehicles and buildings.

A leading automotive glass manufacturer in India produces laminated glass mainly for vehicle
windshields. Windshields must be strong because they protect drivers and passengers from wind, dust,
and possible road accidents. Laminated glass helps reduce injuries because it does not shatter
easily.

A reliable bus windshield manufacturer in India uses laminated glass in buses and coaches to improve
passenger safety. It also helps drivers maintain better visibility in different weather conditions.

## ABOUT US

Perigon has been serving the process chemicals and manufacturing industries with design of new
plants and upgrades of existing facilities since 1982. Our engineers and designers understand that
safety must be an integral component of every project in the industrial environment. Our
professional engineers are experienced with application of codes and standards while providing value
added designs. Perigon is a multiple discipline firm with licensed Chemical, Electrical,
Instrumentation/Controls, Mechanical/ Piping/ HVAC, and Structural/ Civil and Project Management
Professionals on staff which allows assembly of experienced design teams for expedient communication
and efficient completion of complex value added client focused designs. Perigon often supports
pre-project planning with preliminary engineering and Total Installed Cost estimates to support
client planning and capital appropriation.

[Continue Reading...][48]

## WHY CHOOSE US

#### Full Service Multi-Discipline Capabilities

We take our name from the geometric angle of 360 degrees representing the full circle of engineering
services we provide. Our multiple discipline structure and long-standing strategic partnerships
combine to provide the expected full engineering coverage.

#### Industrial Expertise

Our clients benefit from decades of plant design experience and our core competency in industrial
facilities engineering and design.

#### Quality Assurance

As a quality-driven company our operating procedures focus on sound project management principals,
inter-discipline coordination and appropriate attention to detail while encouraging innovation and
value-added design.

#### Responsiveness

We believe in prompt turn-around times with client inquiries, RFI’s, or replies to correspondence.
Our team understands that people do business with people and often a quick response goes a long way!

## ABOUT US

Perigon has been serving the process chemicals and manufacturing industries with design of new
plants and upgrades of existing facilities since 1982. Our engineers and designers understand that
safety must be an integral component of every project in the industrial environment. Our
professional engineers are experienced with application of codes and standards while providing value
added designs. Perigon is a multiple discipline firm with licensed Chemical, Electrical,
Instrumentation/Controls, Mechanical/ Piping/ HVAC, and Structural/ Civil and Project Management
Professionals on staff which allows assembly of experienced design teams for expedient communication
and efficient completion of complex value added client focused designs. Perigon often supports
pre-project planning with preliminary engineering and Total Installed Cost estimates to support
client planning and capital appropriation.

# Looking for vintage auto glass that looks great and fits perfectly?

[imgCar1] Sanders Reproduction Glass is a division of Peninsula Glass Company and has been in
business for over 30 years! Our headquarters is in Vancouver, Washington, USA but we provide
superior service throughout the United States and around the world with fine attention to detail and
unsurpassed service in working with classic auto glass windshields which include hot rods and custom
cars or any other type of classic vehicle. Our goal is your ultimate satisfaction by providing high
quality products, excellent service, at a fair price.

## We provide quality, authentic classic auto glass and classic car windshields and other custom
## automotive glass

Our custom cut, classic auto glass is machined to a satin finish and is guaranteed to fit your
vehicle. Unlike other automotive glass companies, we use the most advanced [glass cutting
technology][33] to ensure high quality and authenticity.

[imgCar2] **For hot rod windshield projects:**
* Custom cut flat glass for chopped tops or modified window frames
* Wide selection of colors and shades

**For restoration, classic, vintage cars, hot rods and custom cars:**
* Choose from our large library of original patterns and sample windows
* OEM Glass windshields, door windows, vent windows, quarter windows and back windows for over 30
  different domestic and 36 foreign auto manufacturers. Take a look at our full list of
  manufacturers

## Our staff will help you decide what glass is right for you and your vehicle.

At Sanders Reproduction Glass, your satisfaction is our top priority. We strive to provide superior
customer service by responding in a timely fashion to your phone calls and emails. Our knowledgeable
staff will help you select the right glass and options for your vehicle by taking the time to
understand your specific project.

## Receive your glass quickly and safely!

Once your order is confirmed, we will start working on it right away. Most orders take about a week
to process. And unlike other companies that ship the glass in flimsy packaging, we ensure the safe
arrival of your order by shipping in sturdy custom packaging…including wooden boxes for larger
items. If by chance the glass arrives damaged, we guarantee that we will replace the glass and
ensure that your needs are met even before we make a claim on the shipping company.

Vancouver, WA 98682

TGI is an independent and family run automotive glass distributor located in San Jose, California,
and has been in business for over 40 years. We carry a variety of automotive glass from popular
numbers to obsolete and rare items, as well as regular aftermarket and original equipment brands.

Customer service is at the heart of our business and our enthusiastic staff is always available to
look up parts, list prices, and labor hours. We offer additional help over the phone, providing an
overall pleasant experience for our customers and complimentary VIN number look up as well. Our
average turnaround time for our will call customers is the fastest in the greater Bay Area.

# Asahi India Glass Ltd (AIS)

Asahi India Glass Ltd (AIS) is India’s leading integrated glass and window solutions company and a
dominant player both in the automotive and the building & construction segments. Our product
solutions spanning the entire breadth of automotive, building & construction, and consumer glass,
are designed to deliver aesthetics and functional benefits.

## [AUTOMOTIVE][43]

AIS is the preferred choice of leading transport players as well as consumers of automotive glass
products. We are specialists in creating innovative glass solutions for anything that moves on
wheels, rails, water or air. Our glass solutions in the category span the entire breadth of
passenger vehicles from mass modes of transportation (buses and trains) to ships and yachts. Our
glasses are also used in defence vehicles.

## [BUILDING AND CONSTRUCTION][44]

AIS is a transformation leader in the world of architectural glass products and services. Our
architectural portfolio includes various glass solutions for exterior and interior architecture. Be
it residential or commercial projects, our premium glass solutions can be customised to optimally
suit individual design sensibilities. From privacy to safety, from thermal comfort to acoustic
insulation, our glass solutions offer the right blend of aesthetics and functionality.

## [CONSUMER ][45]

AIS caters to the modern consumer’s needs with its varied products and services under different
Strategic Business Units (SBUs) and brands. Depending upon individual needs, our customised
offerings extend from windshield repair and replacement to premium car-care services for the
automotive segment. For the windows and doors segment in residential spaces, we offer bespoke
offerings and 360-degree glass and frame solutions, specially built for institutional businesses and
homeowners, alike.

## [INDUSTRIAL ][46]

AIS is a well-known brand in the arena of industrial glass. It offers an exclusive range of glass
solutions, specifically designed for the unique needs of industries dealing in consumer durables,
commercial refrigeration, dynamic glazing and material handling vehicles. The technical, aesthetic,
energy and safety performance of our premium glass solutions make their scope of applications
practically unlimited for the industrial segment.

# Automotive Glass Experts (AGE)

Automotive Glass Experts (AGE) is a distinguished consortium of specialists in the field of
automotive glass services. With over 15 years of experience, they have built a solid reputation as a
trusted reference in the industry.

Operating in 26 countries across Europe, North America, Asia,
and Africa, AGE has established a robust global network. This expansive reach allows them to provide
high-quality services across borders through collaborative partnerships within their network.

[ Learn More ][31]


## Main Services

Our automotive glass services are delivered by a unique network of AGE member companies that offer
customized solutions to meet all your needs.

[ [automotive glass repair] ][32]

[ Glass Repair ][33]

Our team of specialist glass professionals approaches every repair with precision and expertise,
prioritizing safety and quality above all else. Furthermore, our repairs strictly adhere to the
rigorous standards set forth by the BSI, ensuring reliability and excellence in every service we
offer.

[Know more][34]

[ Glass Replacement ][35]

We only use replacement glass from the leading manufacturers for both OEM market and aftermarket and
use the highest quality adhesive from the world’s number one chemical company.

[Know more][36]
[ [ADAS Calibration in AGE workstations] ][37]

[ ADAS Recalibration ][38]

Windshield mounted cameras are key to the function of Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS).
These cameras require recalibration following a windshield replacement in order to ensure the
vehicle’s safety systems continue to work as intended.

[Know more][39]
[ [National Windscreens - AGE member in United Kingdom] ][40]

[ Mobile Service ][41]

Our glass professionals will come to you, wherever you are, to deliver quality automotive glass
services.

[Know more][42]

#### 1. What is safety glass and why is it important?
#### ][44]

Safety glass is a type of glass made to reduce injuries if the glass breaks. Normal glass can
shatter into sharp pieces, which can be dangerous. Safety glass, however, is designed to be stronger
and to break in a safer way. Because of this, it is commonly used in vehicles, buildings, and public
transport systems.

A professional safety glass manufacturer in India produces glass that can handle pressure,
vibration, and sudden impact. This is especially important for vehicles like buses and trucks that
operate on different kinds of roads every day.

There are two main types of safety glass used in the industry.

One of them is laminated glass. This glass has a plastic layer placed between two sheets of glass.
If it cracks or breaks, the pieces usually stick to that plastic layer instead of scattering
everywhere. For this reason, a bus windshield manufacturer in India generally uses laminated glass
for vehicle windshields.

The other type is tempered glass. It becomes stronger through a special heating and cooling process.
A trusted bus glass manufacturer in India often uses tempered glass for side windows and other
vehicle glass components.

Safety glass is also important in modern construction. As an experienced architectural glass
manufacturer in India, companies like Duratuf Glass supply glass that improves safety, durability,
and building performance.

Laminated glass is a type of safety glass made by joining two glass layers with a plastic layer in
the middle. This middle layer helps hold the glass together if it breaks. Because of this feature,
laminated glass is widely used in both vehicles and buildings.

A leading automotive glass manufacturer in India produces laminated glass mainly for vehicle
windshields. Windshields must be strong because they protect drivers and passengers from wind, dust,
and possible road accidents. Laminated glass helps reduce injuries because it does not shatter
easily.

A reliable bus windshield manufacturer in India uses laminated glass in buses and coaches to improve
passenger safety. It also helps drivers maintain better visibility in different weather conditions.

## ABOUT US

Perigon has been serving the process chemicals and manufacturing industries with design of new
plants and upgrades of existing facilities since 1982. Our engineers and designers understand that
safety must be an integral component of every project in the industrial environment. Our
professional engineers are experienced with application of codes and standards while providing value
added designs. Perigon is a multiple discipline firm with licensed Chemical, Electrical,
Instrumentation/Controls, Mechanical/ Piping/ HVAC, and Structural/ Civil and Project Management
Professionals on staff which allows assembly of experienced design teams for expedient communication
and efficient completion of complex value added client focused designs. Perigon often supports
pre-project planning with preliminary engineering and Total Installed Cost estimates to support
client planning and capital appropriation.

We take our name from the geometric angle of 360 degrees representing the full circle of engineering
services we provide. Our multiple discipline structure and long-standing strategic partnerships
combine to provide the expected full engineering coverage.

facilities engineering and design.

As a quality-driven company our operating procedures focus on sound project management principals,

value-added design.

#### Responsiveness

We believe in prompt turn-around times with client inquiries, RFI’s, or replies to correspondence.
Our team understands that people do business with people and often a quick response goes a long way!

# Looking for vintage auto glass that looks great and fits perfectly?

[imgCar1] Sanders Reproduction Glass is a division of Peninsula Glass Company and has been in
business for over 30 years! Our headquarters is in Vancouver, Washington, USA but we provide
superior service throughout the United States and around the world with fine attention to detail and
unsurpassed service in working with classic auto glass windshields which include hot rods and custom
cars or any other type of classic vehicle. Our goal is your ultimate satisfaction by providing high
quality products, excellent service, at a fair price.

## We provide quality, authentic classic auto glass and classic car windshields and other custom
## automotive glass

Our custom cut, classic auto glass is machined to a satin finish and is guaranteed to fit your
vehicle. Unlike other automotive glass companies, we use the most advanced [glass cutting
technology][33] to ensure high quality and authenticity.

[imgCar2] **For hot rod windshield projects:**
* Custom cut flat glass for chopped tops or modified window frames
* Wide selection of colors and shades

**For restoration, classic, vintage cars, hot rods and custom cars:**
* Choose from our large library of original patterns and sample windows
* OEM Glass windshields, door windows, vent windows, quarter windows and back windows for over 30
  different domestic and 36 foreign auto manufacturers. Take a look at our full list of
  manufacturers

## Our staff will help you decide what glass is right for you and your vehicle.

At Sanders Reproduction Glass, your satisfaction is our top priority. We strive to provide superior
customer service by responding in a timely fashion to your phone calls and emails. Our knowledgeable
staff will help you select the right glass and options for your vehicle by taking the time to
understand your specific project.

## Receive your glass quickly and safely!

Once your order is confirmed, we will start working on it right away. Most orders take about a week
to process. And unlike other companies that ship the glass in flimsy packaging, we ensure the safe
arrival of your order by shipping in sturdy custom packaging…including wooden boxes for larger
items. If by chance the glass arrives damaged, we guarantee that we will replace the glass and
ensure that your needs are met even before we make a claim on the shipping company.

[imgCar1] Sanders Reproduction Glass is a division of Peninsula Glass Company and has been in
business for over 30 years! Our headquarters is in Vancouver, Washington, USA but we provide
superior service throughout the United States and around the world with fine attention to detail and
unsurpassed service in working with classic auto glass windshields which include hot rods and custom
cars or any other type of classic vehicle. Our goal is your ultimate satisfaction by providing high
quality products, excellent service, at a fair price.

## We provide quality, authentic classic auto glass and classic car windshields and other custom
## automotive glass

Our custom cut, classic auto glass is machined to a satin finish and is guaranteed to fit your
vehicle. Unlike other automotive glass companies, we use the most advanced [glass cutting
technology][33] to ensure high quality and authenticity.

[imgCar2] **For hot rod windshield projects:**
* Custom cut flat glass for chopped tops or modified window frames

  manufacturers

## Our staff will help you decide what glass is right for you and your vehicle.

At Sanders Reproduction Glass, your satisfaction is our top priority. We strive to provide superior
customer service by responding in a timely fashion to your phone calls and emails. Our knowledgeable
staff will help you select the right glass and options for your vehicle by taking the time to
understand your specific project.

to process. And unlike other companies that ship the glass in flimsy packaging, we ensure the safe
arrival of your order by shipping in sturdy custom packaging…including wooden boxes for larger
items. If by chance the glass arrives damaged, we guarantee that we will replace the glass and
ensure that your needs are met even before we make a claim on the shipping company.
